items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention St. Cyr; the interviewer mentions 'Cyril something? Not St. Cyr' and the interviewee responds with a different name (Buddy Gross).

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, man, he's a fine tuba player.

Who are some of the other tuba players around town here? That particularly impressed you. Who was the fellow who recorded with Louie -- can't think of his name, now. Cyril something? Not St. Cyr -- my mind's blank.
Well, who were some of the other tuba players around Chicago?
